Name: More Gentle Pig Sound
Author: 4KMong
Description:
Credits the original sound source :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4nXZsgj-OR8

-----------------------------------

Of course, I didn't use it as it is,
I've just tried to extract a sound that wasn't too distant from the actual pig sound and wasn't annoying.
―The pig sound was harder to listen than I thought ;) I didn't know that before.

If you are hesitant to install,
you can download it as manual and listen to the wav file in the [assets] folder first before installing it.

There is no hold or update because it is a simple mod.
I have confirmed to myself that it works in 1.6.

Thank you.

Manifest.Description: This mode replaces the original pig sound with a cuter pig sound.
